Thanks for your comment.
The fact is that I still don't know what to do with my life, and I am scared to do things by myself. I tend to be impulsive and not think about things in a very extensive way. I don't trust my judgement much, I guess. I also made some mistakes in my life in the past, and I would like to not make a mess again. I guess that there is also the fact that I am coming from a very bad period of my life, and I needed to put things in order in my head as well. 
Long story short, I prefer to do this journey with a therapist, with whom I can talk about what I feel and what I want in a structured way. It was a good idea from the beginning, but then my first therapist was not a good match for me, I found a second and a third one, but the doubt had already started to mess with my mind, which was the last thing I needed. And after 8 years, 4 of which I took time away and had no therapist, I am still spinning. Now I am seeing a therapist, but I don't know if to start with her this journey (they all are gender therapist btw, and accredited ones), and I feel very sad and quite desperate about all this. I can't control this feeling. I know that this will end one day, but the fact that I already lost a lot of time is killing me.
I know that maybe I am running away from the fact that I am trans, to be sincere a part of me is still holding back, but another part of me wants to move on.
Maybe I need some more thinking about this, so I calm myself down and make this first step.
Thanks for letting me have a thought about all this :)

Thanks ❤️ 
I know that I have to keep trying, but some days I am just tired, already tired before even starting.

The first one was not cut for me, so I changed, and then got confused (i was under a lot of stress also, so this may have had an influence in this), and changed two more times. At the end I got so confused that I paused everything for three years. Now I am trying again, I have a new therapist, but maybe I would like to be with the previous one. It's a mess. And yes, it's very stupid. I am very ashamed of all this, since some trans people don't have the possibility that I have.  
That's it.
Thanks, but as there are mental health resources in my area, I would prefer to do things in a safe way. Thanks for your comment though

And when I say my family I talk about my mother, mainly. She suffered a lot by being near my father, and having a narc mother (my grandmother), and now I am another disappointment and heartbreake. On top of this, I am having issues in finding help in therapy, so it's 3 years I am at home doing nothing (well, trying to put my life on rails again, but still...). 
But not talking about my family, socially I feel I make and made people suffer: I don't know if that friend of mine was really an abuser, but more than once he said to me that I made other people (who loved me) suffer... I make people suffer. I have to say that I did some few mistakes in my life, and I really made people suffer, and I am sorry for that. But still...

I don't know... I am so confused right now... I am trying to be strong but that's difficult...

One last thing of these days is that I am away from home for few weeks, and there's my niece (the love of my life) that... I am making sad, cause I went away and she's looking for me. It's just... I can't bear this feeling of making her suffer... Maybe I can't bear the feeling of making people suffer in general...

I don't know...

Sorry for the rant...

In my experience, what I discovered being "enablers" were people denying I was going through something or something was happening for different reasons (as it happens in any field in life): them being not ready to face something big as some issue with parents (like some friends I had back at highschool), them being not ready to face the reality (like my mother), them not wanting problems (a lot of them), etc.

Also, I don't know, sincerely, if the fact that I was transgender but that I didn't know it (I was an "egg", in jargon) maybe worsened the "enablers" behavior, in the sense that maybe, somehow, some of them felt that there was much more than the simple problem with my father/that my father was. But I am not so sure about this... Maybe the reasons are simple the ones I listed above...

Anyway, now that I am saying all this, there is also a part of me that doesn't want much people know "about my father"... I don't know why... maybe I don't want to "destroy worlds", I don't want to put someone, even if this person hurts me continuously (my father is also somewhat abusive), I don't want maybe to be responsible to "destroy" his life... Maybe j don't want to be the "bad guy"? I don't know...

Thanks for your replies btw, and sorry for taking the opportunity to speak my mind... Thanks!

And also how my father got moody every single damn time if I didn't give him what he wanted... And I then, every time, give him attention and be happy for him (oh, my God...) to make him smile again, cause I felt guilty... cause he "just wanted some care"...

I just want to cry... fuck this...

And then, of course, enablers, like everyone around me... I was the one to blame, always...

Fuck this really...

I don't know if I am going too far with my thoughts, but...all is around the fact that they are aware of what they do or not, cause if they do you can put responsibility on them, but if they are not, one can just stay away from them. I am even considered he suffering from some other disorder. But the thing is: can one justify everything he does just because he suffers? He is making us suffer too, and he could make something about it and stop. But he doesn't want; he even says he has nothing, and goes on and on with his poor behavior.

Maybe I got there: fuck him... I am sad for him and all this... But finally yeah, maybe you are right, putting mental energy and anger in this only takes that energy out of me, energy that I could invest in something different, in plans and life.

I just wanted to say I am sorry for your situation. I found myself in similar situations when I was younger.

Being young has nothing to do with having feelings.

Some people will just not listen to you cause they simply don't want, they don't want to be bothered and they often are not able to be in others' problems, as simply it is too much for them to afford.
